headline: Ghana Launches Voluntary GH¢28.8 Billion Early Debt Buyback Offer
summary: The government of Ghana opened a voluntary offer to repurchase up to GH¢28.8 billion in Domestic Debt Exchange Programme bonds ahead of their February 2027 maturity date.
why: Executing early debt buybacks is part of Ghana's broader public debt restructuring strategy following its default and international bailout.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Early domestic bond repurchases support national debt restructuring efforts.
